items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They used to call me Little Ski. So that’s where all that come from, from years and years and years and years back.

ctx.x: And the last one, the one who’s living, her name’s Teneski. I used to be just in love with her, puppy love. I used to just follow her around, pull on her apron strings. They used to call me Little Ski. So that’s where all that come from, from years and years and years and years back.
And your father’s? Do you know your father’s mother and father?
